stem: In the table, \(y\) is a linear function of \(x\). What is the value of \(y\) when \(x = 5\)?
solution: Each time \(x\) increases by 1, \(y\) increases by 3, and \(y = 7\) when \(x = 0\). So \(y = 3x + 7\).
verify:
x = symbols('x')
rows = [(Integer(a), Integer(b)) for a, b in figure['rows']]
m = rows[1][1] - rows[0][1]; f = m*x + rows[0][1]
assert all(f.subs(x, a) == b for a, b in rows)
assert f.subs(x, 5) == 22
assert [Rational(s) for s in spr_answers] == [22]
